meta.title: Our Learning Methodology
meta.description: Project-based methodology and active learning (STEM). We foster curiosity and experimentation in robotics and programming.

title: How We Teach Technology
subtitle: We believe learning happens best when exploring, practicing, and making mistakes in a safe and fun environment. Inquiry, exploration, and the significance of what is done reinforce meaningful learning.

pillars.label: Pillar 1
pillars.title: Active Learning (Learn by Doing)
pillars.desc: At codear.la there are no boring theoretical classes. From the very first minute, students interact with code or assemble parts. Theory is introduced naturally as the need arises to solve a practical problem.

pillars.label: Pillar 2
pillars.title: Project-Based Learning
pillars.desc: We guide students to design and execute complete projects that make sense to them. It could be programming a video game to give to a friend, creating a weather station for school, or automating a toy. This motivates them to finish what they start and see the impact of their work.

pillars.label: Pillar 3
pillars.title: Gamification and Computational Thinking
pillars.desc: We design class dynamics that feel like an interactive game. Weekly challenges award badges and symbolic achievements, removing the frustration of error. For us, code errors are not failures; they are 'bugs' that we must hunt down as a team, stimulating resilience and logical analysis.
